meaning:
1) (Qal) to be pleasant, be sweet, be pleasing
1a) (TWOT) sweet, pleasant

renderings.kjv: with whom thou hast taken pleasure

elsewhere.note: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices…
therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those who you have loved, with all those who you have hated. I will…
They won’t pour out wine offerings to Yahweh, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of…
Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to Yahweh, as in the days of old, and as in ancient years.
